steps.name: The organisation's own grievance cell
steps.when_to_use: First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint / docket number.

steps.name: RBI Integrated Ombudsman
steps.channel: CMS portal, email (crpc@rbi.org.in), or physical post to Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre, 4th Floor, Reserve Bank of India, Sector -17, Central Vista, Chandigarh - 160017
steps.when_to_use: If the bank does not respond within the time set out in the source, rejects the complaint, or the complainant is not satisfied with the resolution provided by the bank.

note: Public grievance portals like CPGRAMS or state-specific portals are not applicable for private banking/UPI transaction disputes. You must exhaust the bank's internal grievance process before approaching the RBI Ombudsman.
